done_when: The refusal says which state --resolve needs (a review stopped at the round limit or a stuck loop) and names the real next step for the item's current state, such as forge work or forge close, never the refused command; new repos get it at init and existing repos on upgrade
why: forge close --resolve on a review loop that has not stopped refuses with 'Record the human's choice only on a stopped review loop' and then names the same --resolve command as the next step
